quote: ConCoRD, a framework to improve the consistency and performance of a pre-trained base language model without fine-tuning... applied to more general settings, such as VQA, open-ended QA, and model editing.

Our experiments are broadly designed to answer the high-level question: can ConCoRD leverage the relational knowledge ... without additional data or fine-tuning? ... We evaluate ConCoRD on open-ended QA, VQA, and test-time model editing.

We have presented the ConCoRD framework for enforcing self-consistency in pre-trained language models using relations estimated by pre-trained NLI models, showing that it improves over off-the-shelf performance in a variety of settings without requiring any fine-tuning.
outputs: answers to questions in QA and VQA tasks
generated answers to questions (textual QA and VQA responses)
The outputs include answers to questions in closed-book and open-book QA settings, visual question answering responses, and test-time model editing results.
